text:
Marta (CS): Heads-up — BeaconX org map shows 3 new squads (search, summarization, agent) starting sandbox tests Mon. They're asking for guidance on capacity and an enablement runbook. Possible QPS bump and nightly embedding batch. Anyone available for a quick plan?

Devon (AE): Good catch. Do we have their expected qps / token estimates? Also renewal in ~8 weeks — this expansion could push them toward committed capacity. :thinking_face:

Priya (BeaconX PM): FYI: search team expects ~120 qps peak, summary ~40 qps, agent ~15 concurrent sessions. Embeds batch ~50k docs nightly. Dates: sandbox Mon, canary Tue.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Sounds like a mixed realtime + batch workload. Recommend dedicated pods for search + KV prefix caching for agent sessions. Quick config suggestion:

```
replicas: 3
model: redwood-vicuna-13b-q4
batching:
  max_tokens: 2048
  timeout_ms: 20
cache:
  prefix: true
```

Sam (Solutions Eng): That should keep p95 under ~300ms for search on our perf profile.

Jules (Success Manager): Noting renewal ops risk — if they expand, we should propose a Dedicated pilot with burst buffer and a short-term commit. I'll start a draft commercial note. :memo:

Devon (AE): I'll schedule an enablement + runbook session Wed 10am PT. @Sam can you lead the runbook (config, fallbacks, perf numbers)?

Sam (Solutions Eng): Yep. I'll add a TL;DR runbook to the shared doc and include fallbacks: route to hosted small model, reduce quant params, autoscale up.

deploy-bot: New deployment plan created: https://deploys.redwood.ai/plans/82456 :rocket:

Priya (BeaconX PM): Please include a short checklist for CISO questions (data residency, retention, KMS/HSM).

Marta (CS): I can own the compliance checklist & enablement materials. Action items: Devon schedule enablement, Sam runbook + perf forecast, Jules renewal proposal, Marta compliance checklist. Reply with ack.

Devon (AE): Ack.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Ack.

Jules (Success Manager): Ack.

Priya (BeaconX PM): Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn. :thumbsup:
